listings.zoningNote: Downtown Fernandina's most flexible commercial district; broad retail, office, and service uses by right.
listings.headline: A storefront condo in the 1884 City Mart Building, one block off Centre Street
listings.summary: Unit B of the historic City Mart Building — 1,511 square feet of ground-level commercial space with double glass doors and breezeway access, in the heart of the Fernandina Beach historic district. C-3 zoning keeps nearly every downtown use on the table.
listings.positioning: For the owner-user who wants a permanent address in the historic district, or the investor who wants downtown Fernandina retail frontage in a building that has anchored the block since 1884.

listings.headline: Two acres of A1A frontage in the path of Yulee's growth
listings.summary: A two-acre parcel (roughly 180 by 485 feet) fronting State Road 200, about two miles from the Wildlight development and the county's fastest-growing corridor. Raw land on the road that carries Nassau County's commercial future.
listings.positioning: For the buyer banking the SR-200 corridor — hold it as the corridor builds toward it, or bring a use and start the utility conversation now.

listings.headline: Commercial land on the SR-200 corridor at Callahan
listings.summary: Vacant commercial land on State Road 200 at the west end of Nassau County, where the A1A corridor meets the US-1 crossroads at Callahan — the junction that carries traffic between Jacksonville, the coast, and southeast Georgia.
listings.positioning: For the buyer who wants corridor land at the county's western gateway, at half the entry price of comparable ground closer to the coast.

listings.zoningNote: Flexible C-3 zoning allows commercial, mixed-use, and live-work configurations.
listings.headline: A renovated c.1883 landmark in the historic district, zoned for nearly anything
listings.summary: 3,745 square feet across a comprehensively renovated Victorian in the Fernandina Beach Historic District, with an elevator serving its multi-level design. C-3 zoning opens commercial, mixed-use, and live-work configurations two blocks from Centre Street.
listings.positioning: For the buyer who wants a flagship address — a firm, a gallery, a boutique hospitality concept, or a live-work residence in one of downtown's landmark buildings.
